For a Indian passport, the photo size requirements are as follows:

/nPrinted Format:/n
  • Size: 51 mm x 51 mm (width x height).
  • Face size: 25 mm to 35 mm
  • Eye height: Between 1-1/8 inches to 1-3 inches
  • The digital size of file should not exceed 100 KB each andmust not be less than 20 KB.
  • Minimum resolution of the file should be 350 pixels(Width) X 350 pixels (Height) and maximum 1000 pixels (Width) X 1000 pixels(Height).
  • Resolution: At least 600 DPI.
